Class ReportSummaryComputer

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.doctor.history.ReportSummaryComputer
public final class ReportSummaryComputer extends Object
Builds reconciled engineer/stakeholder Reporting summaries (issue #5976 / S3-10).

Counts Allure *-result.json finals, then reuses DualFlakeComputer and HealInsightsAggregator for stability / heal tallies. Playbook shapes come from shaft-execution-reporting and shaft-stakeholder-reporting. Never embeds secrets.

    • compute

      public static ReportSummaryModels.SummaryView compute(Path allureResultsRoot, Path reportHtml, Path historyJsonl, Path doctorJson, Path healReportsDir, Path healProposalsDir)
      Computes dual-audience summaries from optional local artifact paths.
      Parameters:
      allureResultsRoot - allure-results directory (may be missing)
      reportHtml - optional Allure HTML path (may be missing)
      historyJsonl - optional history.jsonl for flake
      doctorJson - optional Doctor JSON (path recorded only; contents never copied)
      healReportsDir - optional heal reports directory
      healProposalsDir - optional heal proposals directory
      Returns:
      summary view with playbook-shaped text
